scope: teacher qualification first; no Distillation++ implementation until local qualification and researcher confirmation

model_pair.student: aejion/AccVideo Hunyuan 5-step; not Wan, I2V, Avatar or HunyuanVideo-1.5

generation.precision: H1 verified: DiT BF16; text encoders FP16; shared CPU FP32 noise cast to FP16 initially; persistent native Euler state FP32; VAE FP16 autocast with FP32 latent/scaling_factor
generation.paired_noise: same stored CPU FP32 source latent and hash per prompt/seed, cloned before both arms; H1 confirms exact internal input
generation.time_input: record actual timesteps, sigma and time embedding scaling; verify native AccVideo vs Diffusers at H1
generation.runtime_contract: HYA_RUNTIME_CONTRACT.json for verified numerics; HYA_H2_EXECUTION_POLICY.json supersedes historical GPU and formal panel restrictions only

metrics.direction_quality: larger is better for these four objective proxies
metrics.dynamic_degree_policy: report rates, paired discordance and interval; no automatic tolerance threshold; not monotonic quality
metrics.aggregation: equal prompt weights; one T50-minus-S5 difference per prompt at the single fixed seed 2026101901

bootstrap.unit: prompt pair within its library, conditional on the fixed single seed; never resample arms separately

metrics.qualification: a positive lower bound for >=1 of the four predeclared Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap intervals proposes target-dimension teacher advantage; researcher judges effect size and tradeoffs, then authorizes H3
metrics.interpretation: exploratory fixed subset and fixed seed; intervals characterize prompt variation conditional on this seed, not seed variability or full-benchmark superiority; no guaranteed power or exact coverage
metrics.seed_limitation: no within-prompt seed variance or cross-seed robustness estimate; no automatic expansion, reseeding or threshold changes after seeing outcomes

execution.automatic_gpu_fallback_constraints: only reverified idle devices, bounded backoff and same-GPU pairing as specified by execution policy
execution.qualified_future_migration_panel: reuse these exact 64 prompts and seed 2026101901; no expansion; same-panel tuning is not independent confirmation
